scientific_integrity.checker_scope: Complete graph distances and spectra over finite fields of orders 2, 3, 4 only; not an infinite proof.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Exact five-eigenspace spherical decomposition plus a uniform proof that the bipartition eigenvalue is first to reach zero.

scientific_limitations: Conditional on the existence of a finite generalized quadrangle with equal parameters of the specified order.
The exact powered-distance result applies to point-line incidence graph metrics and squared Euclidean embedding distances only.
Independent mathematical priority and proof validation have not been established.
title: Sharp negative type of balanced generalized-quadrangle incidence metrics
